name: SpaceX
short_description: Reusable rockets with the Falcon family and the Starship program; operator of Starlink.
why_relevant: Made spaceflight cheap and routine for the entire industry.

name: Blue Origin
short_description: Developer of New Glenn and the BE-4 engine for cargo and crew launch.
why_relevant: Heavy-lift reusable launcher now serving NASA and commercial customers.

name: Astranis
short_description: Builds dedicated micro-geostationary satellites that split a GEO slot into beams.
why_relevant: Dedicated connectivity for underserved GEO regions at a fraction of legacy cost.

name: Relativity Space
short_description: Prints its rockets with robotic wire-arc additive manufacturing.
why_relevant: Swapped thousands of rocket parts for a handful of 3D-printed ones.

name: Firefly Aerospace
short_description: Operator of the Alpha rocket and Blue Ghost lunar lander.
why_relevant: First commercial lander to fully succeed on the Moon in 2025.

name: ABL Space Systems
short_description: Designed the RS1 rocket for launch from shipping containers.
why_relevant: Pushed toward extremely mobile, low-cost launch sites.

name: Planet Labs
short_description: Operates the biggest fleet of Earth-imaging satellites, imaging the whole planet daily.
why_relevant: Imaged the entire Earth's land mass every day for agriculture and defense.

name: Spire Global
short_description: Provides weather, AIS and RF data from a global small-sat constellation.
why_relevant: Complements forecast models with dense atmospheric probe data.

name: Kepler Communications
short_description: Runs a data-relay constellation connecting satellites in low Earth orbit.
why_relevant: Creates the data highways that let satellites talk to Earth once a day.

name: ICEYE
short_description: Synthetic-aperture radar satellites that see through clouds day and night.
why_relevant: Radar imaging market leader for insurance and maritime surveillance.

name: Capella Space
short_description: High-frequency SAR satellite tasking for defense and intelligence.
why_relevant: Rapid revisit SAR that supports day-and-night surveillance anywhere.

name: Astroscale
short_description: Removes space debris and services satellites in orbit.
why_relevant: First commercial demonstration of docking to and de-orbiting junk.

name: Pixxel
short_description: Deploys hyperspectral satellites to map the chemical fingerprint of the Earth.
why_relevant: Demonstrates how spectral data can detect spills, crops and minerals.

name: Satellogic
short_description: High-resolution sub-meter imaging constellation from Latin America.
why_relevant: Latin America's champion in commercial high-resolution EO.

name: Umbra
short_description: High-resolution SAR with frequent revisits from a smaller sensor.
why_relevant: Defense and climate clients buy quick, affordable radar change detection.

name: Loft Orbital
short_description: Rideshare operator that flies customer payloads on a standardized satellite bus.
why_relevant: Turns space missions into the simplicity of renting a server.

name: Vyoma
short_description: Tracks space debris with optical sensors and provides early collision warnings.
why_relevant: Protects low-Earth orbit value from a growing debris population.

name: Sierra Space
short_description: Developer of the Dream Chaser spaceplane and inflatable station modules.
why_relevant: NASA-certified cargo spaceplane path to a commercial LEO economy.

name: Isar Aerospace
short_description: Builds the Spectrum rocket for dedicated small-satellite launches.
why_relevant: Europe's privately funded answer for sovereign small launch.

name: Rocket Factory Augsburg
short_description: Develops the RFA One rocket and first gained Europe's offshore launch permit.
why_relevant: Serial-production launch concept designed for hundreds of flights a year.

name: Skyroot Aerospace
short_description: First Indian private rocket company to reach space with Vikram.
why_relevant: Opened the commercial small-launch market in India.

name: Agnikul Cosmos
short_description: Develops the Agnibaan rocket with 3D-printed semi-cryogenic engines.
why_relevant: India's first private singularity launch with a fully 3D-printed engine.

name: PLD Space
short_description: Made Europe's first private rocket launch, the Miura 1, then Miura 5.
why_relevant: Southern Europe's sovereign access to orbit through recoverable rockets.

name: Momentus
short_description: Provides in-space transport and tug services to arbitrary orbits.
why_relevant: Transports small satellites to precision orbits after rideshare.

name: The Exploration Company
short_description: Develops Nyx, a reusable orbital capsule for cargo and crew.
why_relevant: European modular capsule serving commercial LEO stations.

name: Axiom Space
short_description: Files private astronaut missions and builds commercial space stations.
why_relevant: First commercial modules slated to dock to the ISS then detach as a station.

name: Vast
short_description: Builds the Haven private space station, the first commercial VLEO habitat.
why_relevant: Plans the first all-commercial crewed station earlier than incumbents.

name: Sidus Space
short_description: Builds LizzieSat buses for on-demand missions including defense.
why_relevant: Quirky standardized bus that lets anyone fly a payload fast.

name: AstroForge
short_description: Aims to refine metals in space and bring them back to Earth.
why_relevant: First private company to put a tanker prototype into orbit for asteroid mining.

name: K2 Space
short_description: Builds large standard buses for mega satellites and constellations.
why_relevant: Low-cost high-power buses sized for the next API generation of satellites.

name: Impulse Space
short_description: Builds the Helios and Mira orbital tugs for in-space transport.
why_relevant: High-ΔV tugs promise same-day inter-orbit rideshare deliveries.

name: Terran Orbital
short_description: Designs and manufactures smallsats for defense constellations.
why_relevant: Key manufacturing partner for large US defense constellations.
